models.code:
class Customer(Base):
    __tablename__ = "customer"

    Id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, autoincrement=True)
    Name = Column(String)
    CreditLimit = Column(Decimal)
    Balance = Column(Decimal)
models.description: Represents a customer of the system. Includes balance and credit limit.
models.name: Customer

models.code:
class Order(Base):
    __tablename__ = "order"

    Id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, autoincrement=True)
    CustomerId = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("customer.Id"))
    DateShipped = Column(DateTime)
    Notes = Column(String)
    AmountTotal = Column(Decimal)
models.description: Represents an order made by a customer. Includes the total amount and a notes field.
models.name: Order

models.code:
class Item(Base):
    __tablename__ = "item"

    Id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, autoincrement=True)
    OrderId = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("order.Id"))
    ProductId = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("product.Id"))
    Quantity = Column(Integer)
    UnitPrice = Column(Decimal)
    Amount = Column(Decimal)
models.description: Represents items included in an order. Stores quantity, unit price, and total amount.
models.name: Item

models.code:
class Product(Base):
    __tablename__ = "product"

    Id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, autoincrement=True)
    Name = Column(String)
    UnitPrice = Column(Decimal)
models.description: Represents products that can be ordered. Stores the unit price.
models.name: Product

rules.name: CustomerBalanceConstraint
rules.description: The Customer's balance must be less than the credit limit
rules.code:
Rule.constraint(validate=Customer,
                as_condition=lambda row: row.Balance <= row.CreditLimit,
                error_msg="Customer balance ({row.Balance}) exceeds credit limit ({row.CreditLimit})")

rules.name: CustomerBalanceSum
rules.description: The Customer's balance is the sum of the Order amount_total where date_shipped is null.
rules.code: Rule.sum(derive=Customer.Balance, as_sum_of=Order.AmountTotal, where=lambda row: row.DateShipped is None)

rules.name: OrderAmountTotalSum
rules.description: The Order's amount_total is the sum of the Item amount.

rules.name: ItemAmountFormula
rules.description: The Item amount is the quantity * unit_price.

rules.name: ItemUnitPriceCopy
rules.description: The Item unit_price is copied from the Product unit_price.

rules.name: OrderToKafka
rules.description: Send the Order to Kafka topic 'order_shipping' if the date_shipped is not None.
rules.code:
Rule.after_flush_row_event(on_class=Order, calling=kafka_producer.send_row_to_kafka,
                            if_condition=lambda row: row.DateShipped is not None,
                            with_args={"topic": "order_shipping"})
